verdict.rationale: Phone and voice handling is a fair axis for an AI customer-support agent platform, but the evidence only documents ticketing-system integrations (Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain, Pylon), email, live chat, Slack, and an API channel. Nothing shows speech-in/speech-out or telephony. The API that runs the agent 'wherever you implement it' is a developer building block, not a voice capability.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent handles phone calls — speech in, speech out — with the same knowledge and actions as chat
